text_en: When the rule of Rehoboam was established and he grew strong, he abandoned the law of the Lord , he and all Israel with him.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕的国家一强盛，势力一巩固，即舍弃了上主的法律，全以色列人也附和他。

text_en: In the fifth year of King Rehoboam, because they had been unfaithful to the Lord , King Shishak of Egypt came up against Jerusalem
text_cn: 由于他们背叛了上主，勒哈贝罕第五年，埃及王史沙克就上来进攻耶路撒冷，

text_en: with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand cavalry. A countless army came with him from Egypt—Libyans, Sukkiim, and Ethiopians.
text_cn: 率领一千二百辆战车，六万骑兵，和同他一起由埃及来的无数利比亚人，稣基因人和雇士人组成的军队，

text_en: He took the fortified cities of Judah and came as far as Jerusalem.
text_cn: 攻取了犹大境内所有的坚城，直逼耶路撒冷。

text_en: Then the prophet Shemaiah came to Rehoboam and to the officers of Judah, who had gathered at Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, “Thus says the Lord : You abandoned me, so I have abandoned you to the hand of Shishak. ”
text_cn: 当时，犹大的众首领，由于逃避史沙克，都已聚集在耶路撒冷；先知舍玛雅来见勒哈贝罕和众首领，对他们说：“上主这样说：你们既离弃我，我也将你们抛弃在史沙克手中。”

text_en: Then the officers of Israel and the king humbled themselves and said, “The Lord is in the right. ”
text_cn: 以色列众首领和君王便自卑认罪说：“上主是公义的！”

text_en: When the Lord saw that they humbled themselves, the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, saying: “They have humbled themselves; I will not destroy them, but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath shall not be poured out on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
text_cn: 上主见他们自卑认罪，上主就有话传于舍玛雅说：“他们既然自卑认罪，我必不消灭他们，霎时间我要施救，不使我的盛怒藉史沙克发泄在耶路撒冷。

text_en: Nevertheless they shall be his servants, so that they may know the difference between serving me and serving the kingdoms of other lands. ”
text_cn: 虽然如此，他们仍必作史沙克的仆役，好使他们知道服事我与服事世上的列邦，有何区别。”

text_en: So King Shishak of Egypt came up against Jerusalem; he took away the treasures of the house of the Lord and the treasures of the king’s house; he took everything. He also took away the shields of gold that Solomon had made;
text_cn: 埃及王史沙克于是上来进攻耶路撒冷，劫去了上主殿内和王宫内的宝物，全部带走，连撒罗满所制的金盾牌也都带去了。

text_en: but King Rehoboam made in place of them shields of bronze, and committed them to the hands of the officers of the guard, who kept the door of the king’s house.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕王，只得制造些铜盾牌来代替，交给防卫宫门的侍卫长保管。

text_en: Whenever the king went into the house of the Lord , the guard would come along bearing them, and would then bring them back to the guardroom.
text_cn: 每逢王进入上主的殿时，侍卫便来，手持这些盾牌；事后仍将盾牌送回侍卫室中。

text_en: Because he humbled himself the wrath of the Lord turned from him, so as not to destroy them completely; moreover, conditions were good in Judah.
text_cn: 由于君王自卑认罪，上主对他息怒，没有完全将他消灭；何况在犹大还有善事。

text_en: So King Rehoboam established himself in Jerusalem and reigned. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he began to reign; he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem, the city that the Lord had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel to put his name there. His mother’s name was Naamah the Ammonite.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕王在耶路撒冷又渐强盛，继续为王；他登极时年四十一岁，在上主从以色列各支派中选出归他名下的耶路撒冷城中，作王十七年；他的母亲名叫纳阿玛，是阿孟人。

text_en: He did evil, for he did not set his heart to seek the Lord .
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕行为邪恶，因为他没有专心致志寻求上主。

text_en: Now the acts of Rehoboam, from first to last, are they not written in the records of the prophet Shemaiah and of the seer Iddo, recorded by genealogy? There were continual wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕的前后事迹都按着族谱记载在先知舍玛雅和先见者依多的《言行录》上。勒哈贝罕与雅洛贝罕之间不断发生战争。

text_en: Rehoboam slept with his ancestors and was buried in the city of David; and his son Abijah succeeded him.
text_cn: 勒哈贝罕与列祖同眠，葬在达味城；他的儿子阿彼雅继位为王。
